## Overview

MarkdStage v2.6.0 expands Architecture DSL v1 with native PowerPoint-compatible shapes and
connector line patterns, while the source-backed architecture designer gains responsive,
nonmodal editing panels, improved placement, safer focus and empty states, and direct
source-backed editing from the canvas.

The renderer, PowerPoint export, Canvas Extension, CLI watch mode, documentation, and generated
Agent Skills are updated together for the new architecture editing workflow.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible with existing MarkdStage Markdown decks and preserves
Architecture DSL v1 compatibility. Existing shape values and CLI commands continue to work.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v2.6.0`. |
| Offline CLI installation | Download and install `markdstage-markdstage-2.6.0.tgz` from the GitHub Release. |
| Architecture diagrams | No migration is required; the new shapes and connector dash patterns are additive. |
